messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #4123 adds new SDK snippets (Python + Rust) to the Authentication guide and tweaks mkdocs.yml search config. I pushed it to get previews but the Vercel preview for /docs/snippets/ is returning 500 when the snippet iframe loads. Not urgent but we should coordinate merge timing (avoid nightly search reindex) and pick reviewers.

joel: Can you paste the Vercel build log / browser console error?

maya: Sure — paste from console:```POST https://vercel-preview-redwood.app/api/snippets 500 (Internal Server Error)TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'cors') at /api/snippets/index.js:45:22```Also Vercel build shows:```warning You have experimental features enabled. Error: Cannot find module 'snippets/manifest.json'```

sam: fwiw the mkdocs change toggles the search ext to use a different manifest path. That could make previews 404 during reindex. If the PR lands during reindex the hosted search could be inconsistent for a bit. Recommend merging during weekday morning window (09:00-11:00 PT) when traffic is low.

maya: Good call. Also the Python snippet uses `requests` with an iframe POST sample which might trip Vercel serverless cold-starts. I can swap to a fetch GET example and inline the expected response to avoid the POST. Want me to do that before approvals?

joel: Yes please — if it's a tiny edit we can do it now. Otherwise request review and we can queue for Friday morning.

maya: Pushed fix: replaced POST with a `fetch` GET pattern and fallback snippet showing mocked response. Also added a short note on local preview: `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` or run `docker-compose -f docs/docker-compose.yml up --build` to validate the snippet locally.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview (Vercel) started for branch feature/docs-sdk-snippets.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview (Vercel) failed — serverless function timeout on /api/snippets. Logs attached.

lisa: @maya thanks. I'll eyeball the snippet style and the wording. If CI still flakes, we should land after the nightly index completes. Who's approving?

maya: pinging @lisa and @joel for reviews. Also @sam for mkdocs config check.

joel: Quick checklist from me: 1) snippets are language-consistent, 2) mkdocs change doesn't break search path, 3) no runtime calls in examples. If all ✅ I can approve.

lisa: scanning now. Small nit: Rust snippet uses `tokio::main` but doesn't show `Cargo.toml` dep. Can you add a one-line note?

maya: Added single-line Cargo note and a tiny comment for the Python fallback. Pushed.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview (Vercel) re-run started.

ci-bot: CI: docs-preview (Vercel) passed — preview available at https://vercel.app/preview/feature-docs-sdk-snippets (note: function cold-start may still show 500 on first invocations).

sam: Thanks — since CI passed I recommend holding merge until tomorrow 09:00 PT to let search reindex finish and avoid transient 404s for the new manifest path.

joel: Agreed. I'll merge tomorrow morning if no blockers. @lisa can you approve when ready?

lisa: Approved. LGTM. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — leaving a merge hold note on the PR and scheduling merge for 09:05 PT tomorrow. If anything changes I will update here.

joel: Thanks — remind me 10min before merge pls.

maya: Will do.``
